snippet.title: [New Rhythm Game] Milthm Release Date Revealed! Official PV
snippet.description:
Milthm 1.0.0 will be released on 2023/11/17 08:00(GMT+8)
You can find us here: https://milthm.com
Chapter "Rainfall Sounds" unfolds at this moment, and the story begins...

This version includes 3 song packs:
- Weather Report
- Rainfall Sounds
- Dream Tape

And 13 diverse tracks:
- Welcome to Milthm （Milthm Original）
- Blueface
- INFP.mp3 （Milthm Original）
- Jump out?
- Moving On （Milthm Original）
- Oiiaioooooiai
- Oniichan （Milthm Original）
- イコラト （Milthm Original）
- ネオン色のまち feat. Mai
- 命日
- 时落之雨
- 雨女 （Milthm Original）
- 雨之城 （Milthm Original）

Charts:
A total of 12 Drizzle charts, 10 Sprinkle charts, 11 Cloudburst charts, 2 Clear charts, and 1 Special chart
Whether you're a rhythm game beginner or a seasoned player, you can quickly get into the groove.

Modifiers:
The game offers 8 additional gameplay options, allowing you to personalize your gaming experience according to your preferences and needs.
- Auto Play
- Horizontal Flip: Horizontally flip the chart
- Wonderful Trial: Restart when miss or bad
- Astonishing Trial: Restart when accuracy below 100%
- Pursuit of Excellence: Make the hit effect of Actual Perfect different from Normal Perfect
- Fade out: Notes vanish when approaching
- Dance: Chaotic note dance
- Downpour: A downpour of raindrop notes
